findings.message:
[P2] Preserve capped names when replaying tool calls

For the new 64-character namespace/function collision, the adapter records only a chat-name-to-original mapping. The response exposes the original name and namespace, but replaying that item through `chatToolCallItem` sends the bare original name while the next request advertises the truncated namespaced name; with the duplicate bare function, the call is associated with the wrong tool. Keep an original-to-chat mapping and apply it to provider-bound replayed calls.

src/deepseek/chat-projection.ts:556-557

summary: The 128-character cap and focused boundary test are present, but capped names are not preserved during tool-call replay.

evidence: `uniqueChatName` bounds the base name to 128 characters and reserves space for every uniqueness suffix.
`tests/deepseek-responses.test.ts` adds a focused 64-character function/64-character namespace case and asserts the generated names, suffix, and 128-character limit.
